name: worker-agents
description: Generic Node.js control plane for running local agent workers.

scripts.start:clean-9router: lsof -tiTCP:20128 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; rm -rf "$HOME/9router" "$HOME/.9router" /tmp/9router.log && node src/server.js
scripts.start:clean-opencode: lsof -tiTCP:18924 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; npm uninstall -g opencode-ai || true; rm -rf "$HOME/.opencode" /tmp/agent-console-agent-opencode.log && node src/server.js
scripts.start:clean-all: lsof -tiTCP:20128 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; lsof -tiTCP:18924 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9; npm uninstall -g opencode-ai || true; rm -rf "$HOME/9router" "$HOME/.9router" /tmp/9router.log "$HOME/.opencode" /tmp/agent-console-agent-opencode.log && node src/server.js
scripts.check: node --check scripts/prepare-owned-9router.mjs && node --check scripts/self-check.mjs && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/auth.js && node --check src/agents.js && node --check src/9router.js && node --check src/setup.js && node --check src/skill-hub.js && node --check src/rules.js && node --check src/server.js
